nusmp.skill.book_vine.description: A grimoire of living vines, thorns and tendrils. Its pages fling thorns, crack a vine whip, tangle a thicket, whirl every vine in reach inward, grow a thorned armour over you, and call a serpent and walls of vine. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_bolt: Vine Magic: Thorn Dart - a thorn flung on a vine: it pierces everything on its line and pricks with poison.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_cut: Vine Magic: Vine Whip - a whip of vine along a line: it cuts everything on it and hauls it toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_field: Vine Magic: Thicket - a thicket at the aimed point for 8 seconds: foes are tangled, pricked and drained of a little magicule. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_domain: Vine Magic: Verdant Maelstrom - every vine round the aimed point whirls inward: foes are dragged to the middle, cut and held.
nusmp.page.book_vine.attribute_guard: Vine Magic: Thorn Mantle - the Thornbine armour grows over you for 10 seconds, vines climbing the body piece by piece: blows are softened and whoever strikes you is rooted and pricked.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_serpent: Vine Magic: Vine Serpent - a serpent of vine hunts the nearest foe for 15 seconds, biting, rooting and poisoning. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_wall: Vine Magic: Thicket Wall - a wall of living vines rises in front of you; thorns tear whoever leans on it.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_swing: Vine Magic: Vine Swing - a vine thrown at the aimed point hauls you there; foes at the landing are caught.
nusmp.page.book_vine.strangling_bloom: Vine Magic: Strangling Bloom - vines bind one foe (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock): they tighten and feed on its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_vine.lash_barrage: Vine Magic: Lash Barrage - for 3 seconds whips of vine lash at up to three foes at a time.
